name: Add Stat chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/add (ene|agi|vit|str|cmd) (amount)'. Adds the specified amount of stat points to the specified attribute of the character.

name: Add agility chat command
description: Adds the specified amount of agility points to the character.

name: Add command chat command
description: Adds the specified amount of command points to the character.

name: Add energy chat command
description: Adds the specified amount of energy points to the character.

name: Add strength chat command
description: Adds the specified amount of strength points to the character.

name: Add vitality chat command
description: Adds the specified amount of vitality points to the character.

name: Ban Account command
description: Handles the chat command '/banacc <acc>'. Bans an account from the game.

name: Ban Character command
description: Handles the chat command '/banchar <char>'. Bans the account of a character from the game.

name: Guild battle soccer chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/battlesoccer <guildname>'. Sends a request to the guild master of the requested guild.

name: Char Info command
description: Handles the chat command '/charinfo <char>'. Returns information about the character back to the requester.

name: Chat Ban Character command
description: Handles the chat command '/chatban <characterName> <durationMinutes>'. Bans the account of a character from chatting for the specified minutes.

name: Chat Ban Character command
description: Handles the chat command '/chatunban <characterName>'. Unbans the account of a character from chatting.

name: Clear Inventory chat command
description: Clears inventory. Usage: /clearinv (optional:character)

name: Create monster chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/createmonster <number> <intelligent>'. Creates a monster which can be remote controlled by the GM.

name: Disconnect chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/disconnect <char>'. Disconnects a player from the game server.

name: Show fireworks effect chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/fireworks <x> <y>'. Shows an fireworks effect at the specified coordinates.

name: Get Stat chat command
description: Get stat points. Usage: /get (ene|agi|vit|str|cmd) (optional:character)

name: Get level command
description: Gets level of a player. Usage: /getlevel (optional:character)

name: Get level up points command
description: Gets level up points of a player. Usage: /getleveluppoints (optional:character)

name: Get master level command
description: Gets master level of a player. Usage: /getmasterlevel (optional:character)

name: Get master level up points command
description: Gets master level up points of a player. Usage: /getmasterleveluppoints (optional:character)

name: Get money command
description: Gets money of a player. Usage: /getmoney (optional:character)

name: Get resets command
description: Gets resets of a player. Usage: /getresets (optional:character)

name: Notice chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/goldnotice message'. Sends a global golden notice message to all players of the game.

name: Guild disconnect chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/guilddisconnect <guild>'. Disconnect the guild members.

name: Guild move chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/guildmove <guild> <map> <x?> <y?>'. Move the character from a guild to a specified map and coordinates.

name: Help command
description: Handles the /help <command> chat command. Shows information about the requested command.

name: Hide command
description: Handles the chat command '/hide'. Hides the own player from others.

name: Item chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/item <group> <number> <lvl?> <exc?> <sk?> <lu?> <opt?> <anc?> <ancBonuslvl?>'. Drops a specific item next to the character.

name: Change language command
description: Handles the chat command '/language <isoCode>'. Changes the language of the account.

name: List command
description: Lists all the commands.

name: Move chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/move <target> <mapIdOrName?> <x?> <y?>'. Moves the character to the specified destination.

name: Move remote monster chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/movemonster <id> <x> <y>'. Moves a previously created monster which can be remote controlled by the GM.

name: NPC open merchant chat command
description: Opens the merchant NPC store.

name: Offline Leveling Command
description: Allows players to start offline leveling with /offlevel. The character stays in the world after the client disconnects and stops when the player logs back in.

name: Online chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/online'. Gets the count of game masters and players online.

name: Open Warehouse chat command
description: Opens the warehouse.

name: PK chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/pk <char> <pk_lvl> <pk_count>'. Sets player kill level and count of a character.

name: PK clear chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/pkclear <char>'. Clears the player kill count.

name: Post chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/post message'. Sends a global blue system message to all players of the game.

name: Remove npc chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/removenpc <id>'.

name: Reset chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/reset'.

name: Reset info chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/resetinfo'. Shows the required costs and the granted points for the next reset.

name: Reset Stats chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/resetstats'.

name: Set Stat chat command
description: Set stat points. Usage: /set (ene|agi|vit|str|cmd) (amount) (optional:character)

name: Set level command
description: Sets level of a player. Usage: /setlevel (level) (optional:character)

name: Set level up points command
description: Sets level up points of a player. Usage: /setleveluppoints (points) (optional:character)

name: Set master level command
description: Sets master level of a player. Usage: /setmasterlevel (level) (optional:character)

name: Set master level up points command
description: Sets master level up points of a player. Usage: /setmasterleveluppoints (points) (optional:character)

name: Set money command
description: Sets money of a player. Usage: /setmoney (amount) (optional:character)

name: Set resets command
description: Sets resets of a player. Usage: /setresets (resets) (optional:character)

name: Show NPC ids chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/showids'.

name: Skin chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/skin <number>'. Applies a monster skin to the game masters character.

name: Start Blood Castle Event Chat Command
description: Handles the chat command '/startbc'. Starts the blood castle event at the next possible time.

name: Start Chaos Castle Event Chat Command
description: Handles the chat command '/startcc'. Starts the chaos castle event at the next possible time.

name: Start Devil Square Event Chat Command
description: Handles the chat command '/startds'. Starts the devil square event at the next possible time.

name: Teleport chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/teleport <x> <y>'. Teleports the game master to the specified coordinates.

name: Trace chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/trace <char>'. Moves the game master to the character's location.

name: Track chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/track <char>'. Moves the player to the game masters location.

name: Unban Account command
description: Handles the chat command '/unbanacc <acc>'. Unbans an account from the game.

name: Unban Character command
description: Handles the chat command '/unbanchar <char>'. Unbans the account of a character from the game.

name: Hide command
description: Handles the chat command '/unhide'. Unhides the own player from others.

name: Walk remote monster chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/walkmonster <id> <x> <y>'. Walks a previously created monster which can be remote controlled by the GM.

name: Guild war chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/war <guild>'. Sends a request to the guild master of the requested guild.

name: Show xmas fireworks effect chat command
description: Handles the chat command '/xmasfireworks <x> <y>'. Shows an christmas fireworks effect at the specified coordinates.
